search_plan_yaml:
objective: >
  Systematically identify, retrieve, and evaluate all published and preprint
  literature relevant to the MaNGA zero-dark density null result paper, resolving
  22 dangling citation keys in paper.md and filling gaps in 8 topic areas not yet
  covered by the existing 48-entry manga_null_refs.bib.

scope:
  date_range: "1996-01-01 / 2026-03-18"
  priority_recency: "2022-01-01 / 2026-03-18"
  languages:
    - English
  databases:
    primary:
      - NASA ADS (ui.adsabs.harvard.edu)
      - arXiv (arxiv.org)
      - SDSS documentation (sdss.org/dr17)
    secondary:
      - InspireHEP
      - Scopus
    journal_targets:
      - "The Astrophysical Journal (ApJ)"
      - "Monthly Notices of the Royal Astronomical Society (MNRAS)"
      - "Astronomy & Astrophysics (A&A)"
      - "Physical Review D (PRD)"
      - "Physical Review Letters (PRL)"
      - "Journal of Mathematical Physics (JMP)"
      - "Journal of Cosmology and Astroparticle Physics (JCAP)"
  exclusions:
    - Ecology, pharmacology, urban studies, neuroscience, cardiovascular medicine
    - Pure lattice QCD without dark sector constraints
    - Gravitational wave catalogs without halo structure constraints
    - Pulsar timing arrays without dark matter density profile implications

    entry anywhere in the project (manga_null_refs.bib, refs.bib, bibliography.toml).
    This is a compilation blocker.
  method: ADS author+year lookup for each key
  keys:
    - key: adame2025desi

      priority: MEDIUM

      likely_paper: "Barausse+ 2020, GW future prospects with LISA"
      priority: LOW

clusters:

  - id: CL-1
    name: "IFU Kinematic Surveys and Rotation Curve Systematics"
    priority: HIGH
    rationale: >
      Paper relies on MaNGA IFU rotation curve extraction with beam-smearing
      corrections and inclination deprojection. Existing bib has Krajnovic 2006,
      Graham 2018 but lacks Varidel 2019, recent SAMI/PHANGS methodology, and
      post-DR17 MaNGA kinematic studies.
    queries:
      - id: Q-01
        db: ADS
        query: 'abs:"MaNGA" AND abs:"rotation curve" AND year:2022-2026'
        expected_yield: 15-30
      - id: Q-02
        db: ADS
        query: 'abs:"beam smearing" AND abs:"integral field" AND abs:"rotation curve" AND year:2018-2026'
        expected_yield: 8-15
      - id: Q-03
        db: ADS
        query: 'abs:"IFU" AND abs:"kinematic" AND (abs:"inclination" OR abs:"deprojection") AND abs:"galaxy" AND year:2020-2026'
        expected_yield: 10-20
      - id: Q-04
        db: arXiv
        query: 'cat:astro-ph.GA AND (ti:MaNGA OR ti:SAMI) AND ti:rotation AND submittedDate:[2023 TO 2026]'
        expected_yield: 5-12
      - id: Q-05
        db: ADS
        query: 'abs:"PHANGS" AND abs:"kinematic" AND year:2022-2026'
        expected_yield: 5-10
    key_targets:
      - "Varidel+ 2019 (IFU beam-smearing corrections)"
      - "Emsellem+ 2022 (PHANGS-MUSE kinematic extraction)"
      - "Recent MaNGA DR17 rotation curve analyses 2023-2026"

  - id: CL-2
    name: "Dark Matter Density Profile Constraints and Stacking Methods"
    priority: HIGH
    rationale: >
      Paper stacks 6992 rotation curves and compares NFW baselines. Need recent
      work on stacking methodology, composite rotation curves, and Einasto/Burkert
      comparisons. Duffy 2008 / Dutton-Maccio 2014 c-M relation used but not cited.
    queries:
      - id: Q-06
        db: ADS
        query: 'abs:"rotation curve" AND abs:"stacking" AND abs:"dark matter" AND year:2018-2026'
        expected_yield: 8-15
      - id: Q-07
        db: ADS
        query: 'abs:"NFW" AND (abs:"Einasto" OR abs:"Burkert") AND abs:"rotation curve" AND year:2020-2026'
        expected_yield: 8-15
      - id: Q-08
        db: ADS
        query: 'abs:"concentration-mass relation" AND abs:"dark matter halo" AND year:2022-2026'
        expected_yield: 5-10
    key_targets:
      - "Dutton-Maccio 2014 (updated c-M relation)"
      - "Recent DC14 profile applications 2022-2026"

  - id: CL-3
    name: "Null Result Methodology in Astrophysics and Particle Physics"
    priority: HIGH
    rationale: >
      Paper is a null result with SNR=0.29 and 95% CL upper bound. Existing bib
      has Trotta 2008, Cowan 2011, Feldman-Cousins 1998, XENON1T 2018. Need
      multi-probe null examples, Baxter 2021 conventions, and injection-recovery
      validation methodology.
    queries:
      - id: Q-09
        db: ADS
        query: 'abs:"null result" AND abs:"dark matter" AND (abs:"upper limit" OR abs:"exclusion") AND year:2020-2026'
        expected_yield: 10-20
      - id: Q-10
        db: ADS
        query: 'abs:"signal injection" AND abs:"recovery" AND (abs:"dark matter" OR abs:"axion") AND year:2020-2026'
        expected_yield: 5-12
      - id: Q-11
        db: ADS
        query: 'first_author:"Baxter" AND abs:"recommended" AND abs:"dark matter"'
        expected_yield: 1-3
    key_targets:
      - "Baxter+ 2021 (DM search reporting conventions)"
      - "LZ 2022/2023 (latest direct detection null results)"
      - "Multi-probe null result examples"

  - id: CL-4
    name: "Spectral Analysis and Red-Noise in Astrophysical Signals"
    priority: MEDIUM
    rationale: >
      Paper reports red-noise spectral index k^0.81 and uses STFT, derivative
      DFT, Rayleigh diagnostics. Existing bib has Torrence-Compo 1998. Need
      Vaughan 2005 (red-noise significance testing) and recent spectral noise
      characterization.
    queries:
      - id: Q-12
        db: ADS
        query: 'first_author:"Vaughan" AND abs:"red noise" AND abs:"periodogram" AND year:2005-2010'
        expected_yield: 2-4
      - id: Q-13
        db: ADS
        query: 'abs:"red noise" AND abs:"power spectrum" AND (abs:"galaxy" OR abs:"astrophysical") AND year:2018-2026'
        expected_yield: 5-10
    key_targets:
      - "Vaughan 2005 (ApJ 635, simple test for periodic signals in red noise)"
      - "Protassov+ 2002 (significance of spectral features)"

  - id: CL-5
    name: "Exceptional Algebraic Structures and Division Algebra Physics"
    priority: MEDIUM
    rationale: >
      Paper tests CD, G2, Albert J3(O), sl(2) frameworks. Existing bib covers
      Dixon 1994, Furey 2016/2018, Reggiani 2024. Need Todorov-Dubois-Violette
      exceptional algebra program, Boyle 2020, and testable predictions.
    queries:
      - id: Q-14
        db: arXiv
        query: 'cat:hep-th AND (abs:"division algebra" OR abs:"octonion") AND (abs:"standard model" OR abs:"dark matter") AND submittedDate:[2022 TO 2026]'
        expected_yield: 8-15
      - id: Q-15
        db: ADS
        query: '(abs:"Todorov" OR abs:"Dubois-Violette") AND abs:"exceptional" AND (abs:"algebra" OR abs:"Jordan") AND year:2018-2026'
        expected_yield: 3-8
      - id: Q-16
        db: arXiv
        query: 'cat:hep-th AND abs:"exceptional Jordan" AND abs:"J3" AND submittedDate:[2018 TO 2026]'
        expected_yield: 3-6
      - id: Q-17
        db: arXiv
        query: 'cat:math.RA AND abs:"Cayley-Dickson" AND submittedDate:[2023 TO 2026]'
        expected_yield: 2-5
    key_targets:
      - "Todorov-Dubois-Violette 2018-2021 (exceptional algebra and SM)"
      - "Boyle 2020 (exceptional Jordan algebra cosmology)"
      - "Dray-Manogue (octonion physics program)"

  - id: CL-6
    name: "Next-Generation Survey Forecasts (SKA, Euclid, WALLABY, 4MOST)"
    priority: MEDIUM
    rationale: >
      Paper projects sensitivity to SKA 2030 threshold alpha_zd=0.004. Existing
      bib has SKA Red Book 2020, Euclid 2022, WALLABY (Koribalski 2020, Deg 2024).
      Need post-2024 WALLABY kinematic results and Euclid early results.
    queries:
      - id: Q-18
        db: ADS
        query: 'abs:"WALLABY" AND abs:"rotation curve" AND year:2023-2026'
        expected_yield: 3-8
      - id: Q-19
        db: ADS
        query: 'abs:"SKA" AND abs:"HI" AND abs:"rotation curve" AND abs:"dark matter" AND year:2022-2026'
        expected_yield: 5-10
      - id: Q-20
        db: ADS
        query: 'abs:"Euclid" AND abs:"dark matter" AND abs:"halo" AND abs:"constraint" AND year:2023-2026'
        expected_yield: 8-15
    key_targets:
      - "WALLABY pilot kinematic results 2024-2026"
      - "SKA Phase 1 HI survey design updates"
      - "Euclid early results on halo profiles"

  - id: CL-7
    name: "Fuzzy/Ultralight Dark Matter Rotation Curve Signatures"
    priority: LOW
    rationale: >
      Paper cites Bar+ 2018/2022 for FDM soliton searches. GHOST methodology
      is directly applicable. Need recent FDM constraints from rotation curves.
    queries:
      - id: Q-21
        db: ADS
        query: 'abs:"fuzzy dark matter" AND abs:"rotation curve" AND year:2022-2026'
        expected_yield: 5-10
      - id: Q-22
        db: ADS
        query: 'abs:"ultralight" AND abs:"dark matter" AND abs:"soliton" AND abs:"galaxy" AND year:2022-2026'
        expected_yield: 5-10
    key_targets:
      - "Schive+ 2014 (FDM soliton core, foundational)"
      - "Hui+ 2017 (FDM review)"

  - id: CL-8
    name: "Baryonic Feedback, Core-Cusp, and Inner Halo Systematics"
    priority: LOW
    rationale: >
      Paper documents three baryonic systematics (bulge excess, cusp
      over-prediction, IFU edge spike). Existing bib has Martinsson 2013,
      Di Cintio 2014, Read 2016. Need FIRE/NIHAO core formation results.
    queries:
      - id: Q-23
        db: ADS
        query: 'abs:"baryonic feedback" AND abs:"dark matter" AND abs:"rotation curve" AND year:2022-2026'
        expected_yield: 5-12
      - id: Q-24
        db: ADS
        query: 'abs:"core-cusp" AND (abs:"FIRE" OR abs:"NIHAO") AND year:2022-2026'
        expected_yield: 3-8
    key_targets:
      - "Recent FIRE simulation papers on core formation"
      - "NIHAO feedback profiles 2022-2026"

deduplication_strategy:
  method: "Three-stage deduplication"
  stages:
    - stage: 1
      description: >
        ADS bibcode dedup: merge results across queries by unique bibcode,
        retaining the query that first returned each paper.
    - stage: 2
      description: >
        Cross-reference against manga_null_refs.bib (48 entries) and
        bibliography.toml (334 entries) by DOI, arXiv ID, and first-author+year.
        Mark existing entries as 'covered' and exclude from gap-filling.
    - stage: 3
      description: >
        Manual review: remove off-topic hits, duplicates from different arXiv
        versions, and retracted papers. Prefer published versions over preprints.

quality_filters:
  citation_minimum: 5
  citation_minimum_recent: 0
  recency_weight: "2023-2026 weighted 2x; 2020-2022 weighted 1x; pre-2020 only if foundational"
  inclusion_criteria:
    - "Directly relevant to MaNGA IFU kinematics or rotation curve methodology"
    - "Directly relevant to dark matter density profile constraints from kinematics"
    - "Directly relevant to null result reporting methodology"
    - "Directly relevant to spectral analysis of astrophysical signals"
    - "Directly relevant to division algebra physics predictions"
    - "Directly relevant to next-generation survey forecasts for halo constraints"
    - "Directly relevant to fuzzy/ultralight dark matter rotation curve signatures"
    - "Directly relevant to baryonic feedback and inner halo systematics"
  exclusion_criteria:
    - "Off-topic (ecology, medicine, urban studies, neuroscience, psychology)"
    - "Pure lattice QCD without dark matter implications"
    - "Gravitational wave catalogs without halo structure constraints"
    - "Papers already fully covered in manga_null_refs.bib or bibliography.toml"

completion_criteria:
  minimum_new_references: 25
  maximum_new_references: 60
  cluster_coverage: ">=3 per HIGH cluster, >=2 per MEDIUM, >=1 per LOW"
  gap_closure:
    - "All 22 dangling citations in paper.md resolved to BibTeX entries"
    - "CL-1: >=1 post-2022 MaNGA rotation curve paper"
    - "CL-2: >=1 stacking methodology comparison paper"
    - "CL-3: Baxter+ 2021 reporting conventions located"
    - "CL-4: Vaughan 2005 red-noise significance paper located"
    - "CL-5: >=1 Todorov-Dubois-Violette paper located"
    - "CL-6: >=1 post-2024 WALLABY kinematic paper"
    - "CL-7: Schive+ 2014 and Hui+ 2017 confirmed in existing bib or added"
  verification: >
    All ADS queries executed, results logged with timestamps, and
    cross-referenced against existing bibliography. Final count reported.
